info.position: Cloud / DevOps Engineer (AWS) – Software Engineer Background
info.company: Cloud / DevOps Engineer with 1+ year of hands-on experience operating production systems on AWS and 4+ years as a Software Engineer (Frontend & Fullstack). Experienced in designing, deploying, and operating scalable, secure, and cost-optimized AWS architectures, building CI/CD pipelines, and automating infrastructure and deployments. Strong software engineering background enables deep understanding of application lifecycle, system behavior in production, and effective collaboration with development teams, supporting a shift-left DevOps mindset.
responsibilities: ☁️ Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, CloudWatch, Route53), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Docker, Terraform, Ansible, Monitoring (CloudWatch, Nginx logs, PM2 logs)
💻 Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, TailwindCSS, Ant Design, SEO, CSR/SSR/SSG/ISR
⚙️ Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, JWT authentication, MongoDB, MySQL, AWS RDS
🛠️ Others: WordPress, Linux (Ubuntu), Nginx, PM2, Bash scripting, Security (IAM, SSL/TLS, WAF)

list.title: Cloud Engineer / Frontend Lead / Fullstack Developer

Fullstack Developer (03/2021 – 06/2023):

• Managed static assets and logs using S3, configured Route53 health checks, and monitored via CloudWatch
• Integrated payment systems (Stripe, Airwallex) and analytics tools (GTM, Matomo)
Key Projects: bbcincorp.com, visa2asia.com, gleads.vn, BBCIncorp Portal
